text:
Maya: Evening oncall here — posting quick async handoff.

Maya: TL;DR: embedding p95 jump at 19:07 UTC, root cause appears to be increased cold KV cache evictions after a heavy reindex job.

Liam: Confirmed alerts + traces. Triggered autoscale +1 for embedding workers and rolled a single pod to warm the cache.

Sophia: Any increase in 5xx or error logs?

Maya: 5xx stayed flat; user-facing latency only. KV eviction rate spiked from ~120/s to ~480/s.

Diane: That's from the reindex I kicked off earlier (job-2026-09-21-reindex). I should have throttled it — pausing now.

Liam: Suggestion — enable short-lived routing to model-emb-small for requests likely to hit cold cache (timeout >= 1s) to relieve pressure.

Maya: Applied routing override for 20m. Commands run:
```
# temporary route override
redwoodctl route override --from model-emb-large --to model-emb-small --predicate "latency>1000ms" --ttl 20m
# scale up a couple workers to absorb burst
kubectl scale deploy/embeddings-worker --replicas=6 -n inference-prod
```

Sophia: Adding these to incident notes in the runbook. Can you paste the runbook link?

Maya: https://redwood.slack.com/archives/eng-oncall/p1749461234

oncall-bot: Created incident INC-2026-099: Embedding latency surge (S2). Owners: Maya, Liam. Opened 2026-09-21T19:08:00Z.

Diane: Reindex paused and will be rescheduled outside peak. I'll also add throttling to the reindex controller.

Liam: Monitoring: p50 returned to baseline ~4m after override; p95 trending down but still ~1.2x baseline. KV hit-rate recovering.

Maya: Night-shift action items / notes for next person:
- Keep routing override active until p95 <= 1.1x baseline for a sustained 15m window
- Do NOT reboot all embeddings pods at once; roll individually if needed
- Do not resume large reindexes until kvcache eviction rate < 50/s and hit-rate stable
- If p95 > 1.5x baseline, notify #eng-sre and escalate per scale playbook

Sophia: I'll open a small dashboard PR to add an eviction-rate panel to embeddings dashboard and a bookmark to the reindex job.

Diane: I'll draft a short postmortem tomorrow with suggested reindex throttling and a canary plan for the kvcache eviction change.

Liam: ACK — watching metrics for the next 45m. Will escalate if we cross thresholds.

Maya: Handing off now. :white_check_mark:

Sophia: ack :thumbsup:
